posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
Myth-Weavers and RollGate are the two platforms I'm aware of.  I personally found Myth-Weavers a bit arcane to use, though it's feature-rich.  Haven't tried RollGate yet.  Really you don't need much.  Could play here well enough either on the honor system or with an online roller (I like Orokos).

Leffa, I assume you're volunteering to GM?  If so, did you have a campaign idea or two in mind?  I like the idea of adjusting the game style through character creation but PbP doesn't lend itself well to that.  If you did want to go with something like that, a formal guided process might be a good idea (e.g. stealing FATE's system).

posts.name: catDreaming
posts.cooked:
Or, and this is inefficient but a way I've handled solo play via Google Doc:
Round x
Heroes:
- Hero 1: Health, Bonuses, Penalties
-- Minions or extra effects
Villains:
- Villain 1/Villain Group 1: Sizes/Health(if public), Bonuses, Penalties
-- Members of group, challenge status, extra effects
Environment:
- Environment Target 1/Environment Challenge 1: Bonuses, Penalties
-- Members of target, challenge status, extra effects


<ActorNow> does stuff. <ActorNow> passes to <ActorNext>
- List of objects added/modified with current states
